name: What is the typical timeline for a rental property kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a rental property kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rental property kitchen remodel typically takes between 3 to 8 weeks, depending on its complexity. Minor cosmetic updates like painting and refacing cabinets can be completed in 1-3 weeks. A mid-range remodel involving new cabinets, countertops, and appliances usually takes 4-6 weeks. A complete gut renovation that includes reconfiguring the layout, plumbing, and electrical work can extend to 6-8 weeks or more. This timeline can be influenced by material availability and city permit processes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A rental kitchen remodel usually takes 3-8 weeks. Minor updates are quicker (1-3 weeks), while full renovations with layout changes can take 6-8+ weeks.
